li.label: the Strongest
li.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] knows [PAWN_pronoun] is the strongest there is, and it shows.

+20 opinion of young colonists (children, and anyone under 30% of their race's life expectancy: 24 for a human); they have +10 opinion of [PAWN_objective].
-20 opinion of old colonists (over 70% of life expectancy: 56 for a human); they have -10 opinion of [PAWN_objective].
-6 mood while no other hero is awakened in the colony, +4 once another one is.
